summary.one_line: The predictor source build and loader installation are documented with accurate isolated-test and live-game limits.

purpose.evidence: Read the four changed Markdown files and checked the build/check sources. README explains a native deployment-preview prototype, its source build, separate installation and removal, and verification limits. AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING govern changes and review; NOTICE identifies source provenance without claiming official Universe/Nival status.

structure.evidence: README gives detailed Russian build/install/check steps and an English counterpart referencing the same executable commands. It separates compatibility, source build, player launch, uninstall and isolated checks. CMakeLists builds exactly WorkshopDeploymentPreview.dll and workshop_preview_loader.exe into the documented install directory; agent/contributor instructions and provenance are separate files.

specificity.evidence: The clone --recursive/CMake NMake x86/Release/install commands match CMakeLists' MSVC x86 constraint, C++20 targets and install rule. The loader example uses --game with a supported EXE and requires the built DLL beside it; the README warns against placing DLL in UserMODs or replacing Universe DLLs. It identifies devkit gitlink 1b8934ac084491da460ce8bb145819e41e2cf888, four game-binary hashes, nine tests, and H5_PREVIEW_BUILD/H5_WORKSPACE roles.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports both binaries rebuilt from this repo and all nine C++/x86 checks passing with a local game EXE oracle. scripts/check.py imports required dependencies before discovery and rejects unexpected skips; without the game only the named movement oracle skip is accepted, while absent build/compiler/dependencies do not count as success. The README explicitly says no fresh live battle was run after extraction. I did not start a game or rerun private EXE oracle.

evidence.evidence: The source tree contains only C++ plugin/loader sources, CMake, a diagnostic live-check script, test support and Python tests; no compiled DLL/EXE or game archive is tracked in this diff. README's public-input/hidden-composition limit and separation of addressed mouse messages from physical input align with the prior knowledge article. Parent reports source logic preserved except line ending/trailing-blank normalization; I reviewed current source/build declarations, not a bytewise comparison with private predecessor.

applicability.evidence: The README scopes the mod to the pinned Heroes V Tribes of the East with Universe build, rejects hash mismatches and says Python is unnecessary for the installed DLL/loader pair. --pid remains diagnostic; combined installation with bank reference is unverified. Historical gameplay observations are linked to the diary and are not presented as new live acceptance. The normal installer is a separate loader pair, not a universal plugin API.

translations.evidence: RU and EN README sections agree on the two-file build/install, four-hash compatibility, no UserMODs DLL, --game normal launch, --pid diagnostic mode, nine isolated checks, optional game oracle and no fresh live battle. AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING/NOTICE repeat the same ownership, review and provenance limits in both languages. No material contradiction found.

maintenance.evidence: The mod pins devkit/ as a gitlink and records the tested commit in README; contributions require updating README/wiki when install or behavior changes and new exact-diff review before push. Build outputs are under .local, and the repo excludes game binaries and private profiles. review:info lists exactly the four Markdown paths covered here; no source file was edited by this reviewer.
